items.text: Miami (final): OUT - WR Jared Wayne (quad), P Bradley Pinion (groin). DOUBTFUL - CB Jaylin Simpson (knee), S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder/groin). QUESTIONABLE - C Aaron Brewer (concussion, trending up), CB Marcellas Dial (toe). Sat: DTs Zach Sieler, Jordan Phillips and Zeek Biggers on IR (only three DTs left), CB Darrell Baker Jr. activated from PUP, K Daniel Carlson and P Jack Browning elevated. IR - QB Malik Willis, RB De'Von Achane. Kyle McCord starts (2nd straight).

Buffalo (final): OUT - CB Christian Benford (groin), LB Dorian Williams (calf). DOUBTFUL - TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle). QUESTIONABLE - DT Ed Oliver (oblique), DT T.J. Sanders (shoulder), S Damar Hamlin (toe), TE Jackson Hawes (shoulder). CB Dee Alford no designation. Sat: LB Shaq Thompson and CB Tre'Davious White elevated. Josh Allen starts.
items.source: NFL.com Week 11 injury report / Bills roster moves
